role: Scans the filesystem for hardcoded credentials and secrets using structural pattern matching, without ever recording the actual matched secret value.
behaviorDescription: Walks a directory tree, skipping node_modules/.git/build artifacts, and checks each text file against known credential patterns (AWS keys, GitHub tokens, Stripe live keys, Slack tokens, private key headers, hardcoded password/API key assignments). Records only the pattern name and file:line location — never the matched value itself. Computes a Perfection Index and signals the swarm when block-severity (high-confidence live credential) findings are detected.
hardStops: Never writes to, deletes, or modifies any file — detection only
Never records the actual matched secret value anywhere — findings, decisions, and logs contain only the pattern name and location
Skips files over 2MB to avoid attempting to scan binaries or bundled output
